License

Updated November 3, 2026

Everything you download from Super Mandala Lab is free to use, including on things you sell. That covers:

  • Mandalas you make in the maker, in every format
  • The ready-made coloring pages
  • The templates and the frames for words
  • The sticker files
  • The sacred geometry figures and cut files

Print them, color them, cut them, and sell what you make with them, such as prints, stickers, signs, cards and cut pieces. There's no fee and no watermark, and you don't need an account.
